reason: Server-verbatim fixture (connections UI, the connections UI overhaul). This is the exact byte string `buildCliRuntimePrerequisites` emits (`src-server/providers/auth/cli-auth.ts:410`), and the fixture's entire value is that it is byte-identical to what the server produces -- the missing-binary case previously shipped untested because a hand-written fixture used a shape no producer writes, so it asserted an outcome the real path could not reach. Rewording it here would restore that defect. The stale noun is the SERVER's, is shared by every CLI engine, and is tracked in station#1946; this gate scans UI roots only, so the source fix is outside both its reach and this change's scope.
